introHtml: Collapsible lanyards and badges offer a retractable cord that keeps IDs secure yet easily accessible. Ideal for safety managers needing hands-free badge access in warehouses or HR directors streamlining daily check-ins, these reels reduce snag hazards and extend badge life. Choose from multiple retraction lengths and decorative options like full-color imprinting for your logo. Upgrade your team's ID system with a practical, branded solution.
